api:
OV.Screens (additions/changes only; everything else unchanged):
- MONTH_MIN = { alienBase: 2, cydonia: 4 } — recommended minimum «Mês» per Quick Battle mission.
- monthWarn(q) -> string | null — pt-PT warning when q.month < MONTH_MIN[q.kind] (key scr.qb.warn.month), else null.
- lossCauses(B, o?) -> {...previous fields, civ} ; o.mission (full mission spec with squad) is used to know the weapon a friendly-fire shooter left with when he died before the end. New field civ = B.stats.civKilledByXcom.
- lossNotes(B, result, o?) with o = {campaign?, debrief?, mission?}: adds a «N civis mortos pelas armas da X-COM (−X pontos)» cause line (X from the debrief line when given, else the engine formula civValue + 2·civValue/3) and the scr.db.tip.civ tip (also on a non-costly win); the costly-win title only when the main tip is shown on a costly win.
- friendlyHow (internal) order: u.deathDmg (if the engine records it: HE/IN/STUN/SMOKE = blast) → weapons in the shooter's hands → the shooter's starting loadout (o.mission.squad or B.mission.squad) → explosive weapons dropped on the shooter's corpse tile → old rule.
- ui.makeScreen(id, spec): new spec.scroll (selector | false). When no scene key/arrowNav handles it, ↑/↓/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End scroll spec.scroll, default '.scr-brief-body' (so both the Quick Battle briefing and campaign_ui's cbriefing scroll with focus on «Iniciar missão»).
- Quick Battle scene: choosing Base Alienígena/Cidónia raises Mês to 2/4 (note «recomendado para …»), the player can lower it again; a red ⚠ .scr-qb-warn appears right under the Mês row.
- Options scene: «Deslocar nas margens do ecrã» and «Roda do rato» rows hidden when matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)'); confirmBlast/confirmMove hints use the .touch variant.
New i18n keys: scr.qb.month.auto, scr.qb.warn.month, scr.db.civ.one/.other, scr.db.tip.civ, scr.opt.confirmBlast.hint.touch; reworded scr.br.obj.landed.2, scr.br.hint.
New CSS: .scr-qb-warn; @media (hover:none) { .lp-tip .key, .lp-tip kbd { display:none } }.
summary:
I fixed all 6 round-4 screens findings at the root. Each one now has a regression check in a new Node test file and a new Playwright QA script.

1. **FIXED: Quick Battle allowed Cidónia with «Mês 0 · Espingardas» and gave no warning.**
   - Choosing Cidónia now raises Mês to 4, and Base Alienígena raises it to at least 2. The note under Mês says «… · recomendado para Cidónia».
   - The player can still lower Mês. If they do, a red ⚠ warning appears right under the Mês buttons, for example «Com «Espingardas», Cidónia é quase impossível: escolha pelo menos o Mês 4.»
   - I first put the warning in the summary panel. On iPad portrait that panel was scrolled out of view, so I moved the warning next to the control.
   - While doing this I also fixed a bug where a literal «null» was shown in the summary.
2. **FIXED in my files: a win rated FRACO because of civilians killed by X-COM did not say why.**
   - The debrief now shows the cause line «4 civis mortos pelas armas da X-COM (−200 pontos).» The points come from the debrief's own score line when it is available, otherwise from the same formula the engine uses.
   - It also shows the tip «Cada civil morto pelos seus soldados tira 50 pontos: perto de civis não use explosivos … e cuidado com os tiros falhados», including on a win where no soldier died.
   - The campaign debrief gets the same lines, because campaign_ui calls lossNotes.
   - The blastPreview half («atinge 8 aliados» counts civilians as allies) is in battle_ui.js, which I don't own. The exact patch is in open_issues.
3. **FIXED: a rocket kill by a shooter who died later was reported as «tiro».**
   - friendlyHow now checks, in order:
     - the engine's damage type, once the engine records it;
     - the shooter's hands;
     - the weapon the shooter set out with (the debrief now passes the mission);
     - for the campaign, the explosive weapons dropped on the shooter's corpse tile.
   - Verified in the browser: «Mark Williams ← explosão de Aurélie Dubois», with the explosives tip.
   - The real fix at the source is in combat.js (not mine); patch in open_issues.
4. **FIXED: the landed-UFO briefing promised points the debrief never gives.**
   - scr.br.obj.landed.2 now reads «Uma nave aterrada dá mais material do que uma despenhada: todas as ligas e as fontes de energia intactas (com o seu Elerium).»
   - This matches Data.ufoRecovery: a crash scales the alloys down and can destroy power sources.
5. **FIXED for both briefings: ↓/PageDown/End did nothing in the briefing.**
   - The fix is in the shared makeScreen in screens.js. When no other key in the scene uses them, ↑/↓/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End scroll the briefing body, even with focus on «Iniciar missão».
   - This covers the Quick Battle briefing and also campaign_ui's briefing, without touching campaign_ui.js.
   - The Quick Battle footer now says «↑ ↓ deslocam». The campaign footer text is not mine; patch in open_issues.
6. **FIXED (Options and long-press label); the battle HUD's own options are open: iPad showed mouse-only settings and keyboard keys.**
   - On a touch-only device, Options hides «Deslocar nas margens do ecrã» and «Roda do rato».
   - The explosives hint now says «Pede um 2.º toque…».
   - The long-press label no longer shows the key: for example «Fechar» without «Esc», and «Ajoelhar / levantar» without «K». The rule is in css/screens.css, using the same (hover: none) condition that already hides .btn .key.
   - The persona also pointed at hud.opt.wheel inside battle_ui.js. That is the battle fixer's file; patch in open_issues.

**Tests**
- `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n`: 779 passed, 0 failed; the only missing key reported is nao.existe.x.
- Earlier in the session, base_ui, morale and integration_r3 tests failed for a while because other fixers were mid-edit. They passed in the final run.
- New tools/tests/screens_persona_r4.test.js has 7 tests and runs in about 0.1 s.

**QA**
- New qa/persona_r4_screens.mjs: 108/108 checks at 1440×900, 1024×576 and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834 (touch). It covers the Quick Battle Mês bump and warning (also with the colour-blind palette), arrow keys in both briefings, the civilians and dead-shooter debriefs, iPad Options, and a long press done through CDP touch events.
- Existing scripts still pass: qa/screens_check.mjs 49/49, qa/persona_r3_screens.mjs 54/54, qa/full_campaign.mjs completed with no errors.
- I looked at the screenshots of every screen I changed (Quick Battle, both briefings, both debriefs, Options, long press) at all four sizes: everything is readable and no ⟦missing⟧ keys appear.
deviations: Finding 1: the warning sits under the Mês row instead of in the RESUMO panel. On iPad portrait the summary is above the form and scrolls out of view when you tap Mês, so the warning goes next to the control that causes it. It uses the ⚠ shape plus the --red token, so the CVD palette also applies.

Finding 5: the fix is a generic fallback in the shared makeScreen (spec.scroll, default '.scr-brief-body'), not a call inside each briefing's keys(). That way it also fixes campaign_ui's cbriefing, which the persona actually played, without editing a file I don't own.

Finding 6: the long-press .key rule went into css/screens.css because base.css and dom.js are not mine. It applies to every .lp-tip, including Battlescape HUD buttons. Mouse-only option rows are hidden with matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)'), not the last pointer type. An iPad with a trackpad keeps them.
open_issues: battle_ui.js (battle fixer), finding 2, blastPreview at ~l.798: split the risk count. Inside the loop, replace `if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r) risk++;` with `if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r) { risk++; if (f.origSide === 'civ' || f.side === 'civ') civ++; }` (declare `let civ = 0;`), and return `{ x, y, z, r, smoke, risk, civ }`. In the 3 places that build the risk label (hud.throw.risk l.736/783, hud.confirmBlast.* l.742/786), use the plain key when civ === 0 and a new '.mix' variant when civ > 0, with params {s: risk - civ, c: civ}. Example pt-PT.battle.js keys: 'hud.throw.risk.mix': 'Risco: atinge {s} soldado(s) e {c} civil(is)'; 'hud.confirmBlast.click.mix' / '.tap.mix' / '.key.mix': 'Clique outra vez para disparar — atinge {s} soldados e {c} civis' (tap/key wording as in the existing variants).

combat.js (sim owner), finding 3 root cause: record the fatal damage type. In damageUnit (~l.524) call `killUnit(B, u, atk ? atk.id : null, o.cause || 'damage', { rng: r, dmgType })`. In killUnit, after `u.deathCause = cause || 'damage';`, add `u.deathDmg = o.dmgType || null;`. Optionally, in applyImpact's radius branch (~l.430), pass `cause: o.cause && o.cause !== 'shot' ? o.cause : 'explosion'` so rockets are not tagged 'shot'. screens.js already reads u.deathDmg first (HE/IN/STUN/SMOKE = explosion). Until then it falls back to the starting loadout and the weapons on the corpse tile.

battle_ui.js (battle fixer), finding 6 Battlescape half: the in-battle options at ~l.1672-1673 (hud.opt.wheel, hud.opt.edgeScroll) should be skipped when matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)').matches, as screens.js now does. The Geoscape → Opções panel the persona opened is fixed.

pt-PT.campaign.js (campaign_ui owner), finding 5 footer: cp.br.hint / cp.br.hint.night should mention the arrows like scr.br.hint, e.g. 'Enter inicia · E equipar · ↑ ↓ deslocam · Esc cancela'. The keys themselves already work in cbriefing through the makeScreen fallback (verified by qa/persona_r4_screens.mjs step 2b).
